title: Nightly snapshot: a job with nothing approved is captured at $0.00; not skipped
refs: SV-8667 (WIP spec v24 per Chris Ward 2026-08-19; Story 11 S11-R6; Story 4 S4-E1; S11-R7 corrected - the snapshot is read via the "as of" date)
preconds:
1. An open estimate with no approved line items is open on the day you inspect.
2. You can open the Work In Progress report and set its "as of" date..
steps:
1. On the report, set the "as of" date to a day the nothing-approved work order was open.
2. Look for that work order among the rows.
3. Read its Earned and Remaining values.
expected:
1. The work order IS captured (not skipped).
2. Its Earned is $0.00 and its Remaining is $0.00, matching what the report shows on screen for a job with nothing approved.

Note for the tester: you CAN check this from the report. Set the "as of" date to a day the nothing-approved job was open and confirm it appears (in the Estimates tab) with Earned $0.00 and Remaining $0.00 - captured, not skipped.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and story SV-8667 (WIP Story 11), and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S11-R6, S4-E1), as pinned and answered by Chris Ward on 19 August 2026, recorded in his answers in this file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bilalmuzamil-sketch/Manual-test-Cases/claude/slack-session-0sxnd9/build/report-suite/chris-answers-2026-08-19/WIP-CHRIS-RULINGS-2026-08-19.md.
This corrects the older wording (specification version 22), which said nothing in the report reads the snapshot back. Chris Ward confirmed on 19 August 2026 that the "as of" date reconstructs a past day from the snapshot, so that newest source is followed here.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 28 August 2026: every requirement this case cites was read again in the live version and the behaviour above still matches it, so only the version cited above was updated.
